# has gender expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGenderExpression`](gmeow-hasGenderExpression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGenderExpression>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a person to a self-asserted gender-expression facet. Non-functional and contextual. MUST NOT be inferred from [`gmeow:hasGenderIdentity`](gmeow-hasGenderIdentity.md), [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md), pronouns or honorifics.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) -> [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpression.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasGenderExpression`](gmeow-hasGenderExpression.md) from [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) to [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpression.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a person to each self-asserted gender-expression facet; non-functional, so several presentation facets (e.g. context-varying) coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid inferring it from gender identity, sex-assigned-at-birth, pronouns, or honorifics, and avoid treating it as a privileged selector — it is a co-equal facet axis ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point the person at a [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](../classes/gmeow-GenderExpression.md) facet whose [`gmeow:expressionValue`](gmeow-expressionValue.md) carries the style; supersede a presentation with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false rather than deletion.
